answer: Challenge-chain continuity stops bulk fakes: each cipher is hashed from the last answer, so only one chain counts. Each link is sealed in the onyx ledger with a 50-credit work proof; auditors replay it; forks earn zero weight. A fork drifts like a dune; rented forks share one prefix, flagged at once. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 × 50 = 50,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 10,000; an honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its full share.
